title: Dispatch CTW 4: Silent Wire Continues to Sing
summary: The junction is disconnected, but the chorus moves to another line.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Workers cut the buried Hollow Junction wire yesterday. The singing ceased on the trunk line and began on a local loop used to signal the clock tower. No connection between the two circuits can be found.

One phrase is now repeated with increasing clarity: “Hold the eastbound.” Railway officials have checked every scheduled eastbound service. None shows a fault. Mr. Bell says the instruction may refer to a train from 1891, when Hollow Junction’s last shift ended.
